department: Department of Physics and Applied Physics

deadline.value: Neither the physics pages nor the graduate office give a Physics deadline; the graduate office says some programs have fixed dates and advises contacting the department.

gre_general.value: The Kennedy College lists GRE only for Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences, so the Physics Ph.D. does not require it.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are only required for the following programs: | Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE Subject test is not required for the Physics Ph.D.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are only required for the following programs: | Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences.

supervisor.value: The catalog says a research supervisor is chosen once research starts, but does not say whether one must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department says it strives to fund all admitted PhD students through assistantships that depend on availability.
funding.quote: UMass Lowell strives to provide financial support for all admitted Ph.D. students.

also.quote: Assistantships are contingent upon availability and may be subject to change.

entry_route.value: The Ph.D. requires 60 credits beyond the bachelor's degree, and a completed master's thesis can replace part of the entry examination.
entry_route.quote: 60 credit hours beyond the bachelors' degree

also.quote: a waiver of the above requirements for a student who has completed a master's thesis

notes: Physics PhD with a Radiological Science option. Department page repeats the Kennedy TOEFL 79+ and IELTS 6.5+ rule, so no override is needed.
name: Physics (PhD)
